# Kuwait

> [!summary] Data available
> Weak direct coverage: no Kuwaiti dish or recipe dataset, but Kuwait's composite-dish tables live on indirectly, since [[Bahrain Food Composition Tables]] borrows 24 of its dish rows. The only Kuwait-labelled data are [[WorldCuisines]] (12 shared dishes), plant-occurrence counts and 22 [[Exposome-Explorer]] biomarker values.

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 12 dishes, 0 Kuwait-specific.
- [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: Kuwait claimed (Gulf dialect group) for the commercial full product; counts unknown.
- Absent from [[ArabCulture]], [[BLEnD]], [[FmLAMA]], recipe corpora.

## Ingredients & food composition
- [[Kuwait composite dish tables]] (Dashti et al. 2001–2004): candidate, unavailable. It is the main source that [[Bahrain Food Composition Tables]] borrows (24 dish rows), so those rows are the practical route to Kuwaiti composition, although they carry Bahraini labels.
- [[Arabic myfood24 FCDB]]: candidate, commercial (Saudi Arabia, Kuwait).
- [[EMFID (Eastern Mediterranean Food Information Data Bank)|EMFID]]: candidate, priority 1.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[CMAUP]] 15 plants; [[KNApSAcK Family]] 11 records (4 edible / 7 medicinal); [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 3 records.
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 22 concentration values (urinary PAH metabolites from a seven-Asian-country study), the only GCC country there.
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Kuwaiti dish list, recipes or QA; the Kuwaiti FCT itself is not accessible.
- No traditional-medicine data.
